description: This file defines a helper class for logging, providing methods to route log messages through a chain of LogNode objects and replicate android.util.Log functionalities.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A utility class that mimics android.util.Log, allowing log messages to be sent to a configurable LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Routes a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
